entries.source_evidence: Player actual V dialogue on Day275 late-afternoon four-horse coach eastward in western Veyr on road toward Caer Veylan/Eastwatch/Nightglass: "We’ve learn quite a bit more from since we were there last. I wonder if anything makes more sense now." This is a reflective in-character invitation for companion discussion, not V acceptance of a new expedition, commitment to entering any hazard, or additional travel choice. Mara (firsthand Nightglass recollection) recalls the previously known silver-veined heart reportedly recovered from Verdana, Sanguine Sovereign and anchor wording, a Silver Court signet, and a voice saying 'My child'; she explicitly notes these observations are not verified to constitute one family story. Cirren, informed from V/party discussions rather than falsely claiming personal attendance at the original Hall scene, distinguishes evidence from assertions; recommends comparing recoverer/carrier identities, dates, documented provenance and first recorded family attribution in available ordinary Hall records. Mara wonders whether tracing a documented movement route could lead to a tangible physical site associated with V's lost House, without promising birthsite, paternal identity or relic function. Fenar humorously questions trusting a speaking heart, independently agrees verification is wise. This is a concrete eligible INTRODUCTION/OFFER of a possible provenance comparison at Nightglass through an informed companion, NOT acceptance by V and not revelation of DM-only Edric's new findings, source records he has not provided, unread letter held by Tamsin or an unseen hidden expedition. No new witness/source contact, correspondence, facts about parentage, new items, combat, expenses, route mileage, rest or dice. Day275 remains late afternoon on the road, V48/48 HD7/7, Fenar59/59 HD4/6, Cirren51/51 HD6/6, LongRest3/6, provisions6 ration-person-days/feed8 horse animal-days, V purse1137gp7sp6cp, four owned horses/coach intact.

entries.source_evidence: Day275 late afternoon in four-horse coach heading east on maintained western Veyr commercial highway toward Caer Veylan/Eastwatch/Nightglass. After Mara asked which Nightglass experience has stayed with him most, player exact in-character V statement: "The visions… i haven’t had many since then". This explicitly establishes V has experienced relatively FEW visions SINCE the prior Nightglass visit, not that there were zero, not a precise count/date, and not a fresh vision. Mara responds compassionately that she had wondered whether V still experienced them, recognizing the unsettling older Nightglass voice/heart experiences; Cirren observes that V's memories survived the Severing while origin/trigger of these specific visions is unproved, proposes separating hypotheses rather than declaring Nightglass or the heart the cause. Fenar independently asks whether V misses them. Mara asks whether V pursued visions for evidence or felt them as a glimpse of his personal past. No V follow-up response, choice or emotion assigned. Companion dialogue conveys only known facts/hypotheses, not a new memory, supernatural event, rumor, Edric correspondence or private quest revelation. No game time, travel milestone, checks, spells, items, HP, rations, horse feed, money, overnight/encounter roll or resource change. Party V48/48 full V resources, Fenar59/59, Cirren51/51, Mara unharmed; Long Rest3/6; provisions6 ration-person-days, feed8 animal-days; purse1137gp7sp6cp; four horses and coach healthy.

entries.source_evidence: Day275 late afternoon aboard the V-owned four-horse coach travelling east on the maintained western Veyran Commonwealth trade road toward Caer Veylan, then Eastwatch and Nightglass. Following V's earlier statement that he has experienced relatively few visions since Nightglass, the player says in V's own words: "I think I need to know who I was if I am to become who I want to be." This establishes V's expressed personal motivation and is not a decision to accept an unplayed destination expedition, spend resources, open sealed A-04 or declare truth of visions. Mara independently takes his hand and reflects that recovery of former experiences, people, values and decisions matters beyond an ancestral name or power; promises supportive company without claiming new provenance facts. Cirren observes that recorded actions and other people's assertions about V should be distinguished from proof of inner identity and that V retains choice over current conduct. Fenar gently acknowledges the possible loneliness of incomplete memories and wishes to help recover them without insisting on happiness or present certainty. Mara reiterates the already planned Nightglass examination of heart, visions and historical records, not a new accepted quest or magical result. Cirren asks a concrete, open phenomenological question: do the prior visions feel like V's own lived memories or like witnessing someone else's experiences? V has not answered. No time, travel, encounter roll, rest, character resources, HP, inventory, money, prior correspondence custody or NPC offers changed. Current verified Day275 scene resources: V48/48 HP HD7/7 with full short/long-rest combat and psionic resources; Fenar59/59 HP HD4/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3; Cirren51/51 HP HD6/6 full spells; Mara unharmed. Four horses and coach healthy, Long Rest3/6; rations6 person-days/horse feed8 animal-days; V purse1137gp7sp6cp.
